notes: macOS Apple Silicon (including M5) uses the embedded Metal backend compiled into the app via llama-cpp-4 with the metal feature.
No external runtime download is required on macOS; this manifest only records the upstream release tag for parity.
External llama-bench/rpc binaries are not used on macOS in v0.1.3. Benchmarks run through the embedded engine.
Before enabling an external macOS runtime download, pin the real size and SHA-256 from official GitHub release metadata.
